thread:
marco_sales: Heads-up: POC kickoff with Brazilian retail chain tomorrow. They pinned model `redwood-pegasus-2.0` but their team sees failures from `sa-east-1`. Need quick options + security posture.

ida_se: What error are they getting? 404 vs 429 will change the plan.

marco_sales: Paste from their test run: 
```
POST /v1/completions
{"model":"redwood-pegasus-2.0","region":"sa-east-1","input":"..."}
=> 404 ModelUnavailable: model not deployed in requested region
```

tess_infra: Confirmed — pegasus-2.0 hasn't been replicated to `sa-east-1`. Fast choices: (A) route to `us-east-1` (cross-region) — quick but crosses borders; (B) use `redwood-pegasus-2-lite` we run in `sa-east-1` (quantized variant); (C) request a short Dedicated trial in `sa-east-1` (requires billing/commit, ~48-72h).

leo_security: If we route cross-region, that transfers request payloads across borders. Customer asked for "no PII leaves Brazil". We cannot assert that unless we run in-region Dedicated/Private. For POC we can: - require client-side redaction/pseudonymization; - sign data processing addendum with retention limits; or - provision Dedicated in sa-east-1.

nate_solutions: For speed I'd push option B + transparent fallback. We expose a header like `x-rw-fallback: redwood-pegasus-2-lite` and an annotation `x-rw-fallback-reason: region_unavailable`. Also support a strict pin flag so they can refuse fallbacks: `pin_mode: strict`.

ida_se: Client snippet to opt into graceful fallback: 
```
POST /v1/route-config
{"prefer_region":"sa-east-1","pin_mode":"strict","fallbacks":["redwood-pegasus-2-lite","redwood-pegasus-1.9"]}
```

tess_infra: Pricing note: cross-region calls add cloud egress and ~10-40ms extra latency depending on network. Dedicated in-region eliminates egress but has a minimum commit. I'll DM numbers for a 2-week trial.

leo_security: For SQ answers: include exact fallback mechanics, data residency caveats, retention (e.g., logs kept 30 days), and KMS location. If they need "no cross-border for any PII" we must provision in-region private/dedicated.

marco_sales: They also want assurance that a pinned model won't silently change if it's deprecated mid-POC.

nate_solutions: Behavior summary: - pin_mode: strict => requests fail with `ModelDeprecated` error if pinned version unavailable. - pin_mode: allow_fallback => auto-fallback per configured list and we return fallback headers. We can add SLA note for the POC window in the SOW.

deploy_bot: infra-alert: replication job for `redwood-pegasus-2.0` to `sa-east-1` not scheduled. Dedicated provisioning ETA: 48-72 hours after order.

ida_se: I'll prepare a small compatibility eval: 40-50 prompts comparing `pegasus-2.0` (us-east) vs `pegasus-2-lite` (sa-east). Will output CSV with quality / token counts. That will help them decide.

tess_infra: If they accept fallback, I'll enable `x-rw-fallback` header and per-request token logging so you can show cost diff in the POC report.

leo_security: Draft SQ paragraph for "cross-border fallback" and temporary mitigations coming. Need legal signoff before we promise anything nonstandard.

marco_sales: Action list: 1) Ida to share route-config example and client toggle (ida). 2) Tess to DM Dedicated trial pricing (tess). 3) Nate to prepare pin_mode docs and sample error contract (nate). 4) Leo to draft SQ text and loop in legal (leo). 5) Ida to run 50-prompt eval and post results (ida).

ida_se: On it — will drop CSV by EOD and include example curl commands.

marco_sales: Thanks all — I'll update the customer with the eval + clear options (fallback with header, or dedicated in-region).
